title: Leonida Trophy Atlas — GTA VI
listNote: Official names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation Network, taken from Exophase and cross-checked with PSNProfiles and TrueAchievements (see S2, S3). Hidden flags follow the official list's 28 hidden trophies: story and secret trophies stay hidden on PlayStation until earned. Guides are written in our own words for this atlas; where a specific fact comes from another guide it is cited beside the trophy.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.what: Roadmap, missable notes, per-trophy methods, counts and totals (stunts, vehicles, challenges, meditation spots).

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
sources.what: Official trophy names, descriptions and grades as published on PlayStation Network.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
sources.what: Official trophy names, descriptions, grades and PSN progress targets, cross-checked against Exophase.

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.what: Roadmap context: story length, the 100% Completion Checklist unlocking after the story, and the 397-stunt total.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself — there is no separate task and no shortcut. Work through the roadmap stages in order: story first, then the side questlines, then the 100% Completion Checklist, then collectibles and money, and finally the cleanup trophies. The Next up planner in this atlas always shows what is left.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum pops automatically when the last one unlocks.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1. It is the first main mission of the story, so you cannot go wrong: follow the story markers and finish the mission, and the trophy pops at the end. PowerPyx lists story trophies like this one as automatic and not missable.
steps: Start the story and follow the marker to Gone Fishing.
Complete the mission to the end screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1. The trophy unlocks when the chapter closes and the next chapter begins, so just keep playing the story. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter ends — it is the one thing in Chapter 1 that may not come back.
steps: Play all Chapter 1 main missions.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).
The trophy pops as Chapter 1 closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 2. From this chapter on you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which opens up the partner trophies and most of the open-world activities. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
steps: Play all Chapter 2 main missions.
Use the new character switching to try partner activities as they appear.
The trophy pops as Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 3. This is the chapter where several questlines open up — Andy's calls Lucia, Randy's wish list begins, and the jewelry jobs unlock the Snap Gun — so take the side quests as they are offered. The trophy pops when the chapter closes.
steps: Play all Chapter 3 main missions.
Answer the side-quest calls and texts as they come in.
The trophy pops as Chapter 3 closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 4. PowerPyx notes this trophy pops after the chapter's final main mission, Starting From Zero. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter — with no mission replay, a save at each chapter boundary is your safety net.
steps: Keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Play all Chapter 4 main missions through Starting From Zero.
The trophy pops as Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story. This is one of only two gold trophies, and it is automatic: finish the story and it pops. Before starting it, keep a manual save — the game has 15 manual save slots, and PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and end of each chapter because there is no mission replay.
steps: Keep a manual save before the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end.
The trophy pops at the end screen; free-roam continues afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It is a main mission, so it comes to you through the story — play the missions in order and the trophy pops when Breakfast Run ends. PowerPyx lists it as automatic and not missable.
steps: Play the story into Chapter 2.
Complete the Breakfast Run mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It is a main mission, so follow the story markers until it appears, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end. Automatic and not missable, per PowerPyx.
steps: Play the story into Chapter 3.
Complete The Cartel Heist mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play in Chapter 4. It is a main mission, so it arrives through the story — play the missions in order and the trophy pops when Child's Play ends. Automatic and not missable, per PowerPyx.
steps: Play the story into Chapter 4.
Complete the Child's Play mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners in Chapter 4. It is a main mission, so follow the story until it appears, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end. Automatic and not missable, per PowerPyx.
steps: Play the story into Chapter 4.
Complete the Headliners mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, at Vice City International Airport. It is a main mission, so it comes through the story — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. Automatic and not missable, per PowerPyx.
steps: Play the story into Chapter 4.
Complete the VCIA Takedown mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is a main mission, so follow the story until it appears, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end. Automatic and not missable, per PowerPyx.
steps: Play the story into Chapter 5.
Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game 100% Completion Checklist, which unlocks after the story under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion. The bar is forgiving: PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion. You need any 100 optional missions, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 15 of 18 meditations, all 8 large bank jobs, all 39 illegal gang operations and all 15 target decks. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing toward 100% is missable — everything can be done in free-roam after the story. This is the hardest trophy and the last big one before the platinum.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist (Progress, Stats, 100% Completion).
Work the checklist in free-roam: optional missions, challenges, stunts, scans, bank jobs, gang operations.
The trophy pops at 100% — most other trophies fall out along the way.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely, so pick the easiest. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to rack up. Track progress by region under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots. For the 100% checklist you need 300 stunts, so this trophy falls out on the way to A Long Road.
steps: Open the map, Exploration, Stunt Spots to see stunt locations.
Do the quickest kind first — under-the-bridge flights.
Keep going to 250; the counter in this atlas tracks your progress.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touchpad, Progress, Activities — scrolling over each type shows how many you have done. Most come automatically from the story and from working on the other trophies, so this one usually pops by itself while you chase the rest.
steps: Open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see which types are left.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) to find the missing ones.
Do one of each type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 shooting range locations. The gold-medal scores are not too hard, per PowerPyx, and shooting-range play also levels your Focus, which helps with Gunslinger. Take your time, learn each range's targets, and replay a challenge until the gold score lands.
steps: Find a shooting range (12 locations across Leonida).
Play each challenge until you earn gold — 42 gold medals in total.
Replay any challenge you missed gold on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 drone race locations (42 drone races in total). You only need one win per location, not every race. Drone races also count toward the race-type activity for Master of None. Learn each course's turns, then win one race at each spot.
steps: Find a Top Fun drone race location.
Win one race there, then move to the next location.
Repeat until all 14 locations have a win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations. Each race only counts once, so you need 20 distinct wins — replaying the same race does not help. Pick the race types you are best at, learn the routes, and work through the map's race markers. Races also feed the race activity for Master of None.
steps: Open the map and find race locations (40 unique races).
Win 20 different ones — repeats do not count.
Try different vehicle classes if one race keeps beating you.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing location with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge. Fishing also counts toward the activity types for Master of None.
steps: Play through Chapter 1 until Feng Shui (meet Cal).
Wait for Cal's text, then follow the purple fishing marker.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers — available from Chapter 1 — and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it. Pick the one you like best.
steps: Go to the TV at home (or an arcade machine for Bang For Your Buck).
Pick one of the 4 games.
Finish all of its levels to the end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's 5-quest optional questline, which is exclusive to Lucia. It is marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. The quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay available after the story, so nothing here is missable.
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy calls and texts.
Follow the marker to Andy's home in Belville.
Complete all 5 Andy quests; the trophy pops after the last one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It is marked automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams he calls you, then the green KR icon appears in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — find the underwater treasures (use the metal detector on the ocean floor) and bring them back. In total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared. Kenton becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2–3, so the questline is not missable. Track it under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees.
steps: Play Chapter 1 until Kenton calls (after Island Dreams).
Follow the KR marker in Key Lento and dive the marked shipwrecks.
Turn in treasures until all 7 shipwrecks are cleared.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's 5-quest optional questline. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. The quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All quests stay available after the story, so nothing here is missable.
steps: Play through Chapter 2 until Coffee Break.
Follow the marker to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete all 5 Billy quests; the trophy pops after the last one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands in the open world. Only certain questlines count — the named-character questlines (Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, Eddie and others) do not count as strangers. Confirmed counting strands include Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (deliveries), with more still being found. All of them stay available in free-roam after the story. Track your count on the trophy tracker in the trophy list.
steps: Look for stranger markers in the open world after the story.
Work the counting strands: Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and others.
Complete 8 strands in total.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's Wish List: deliver 16 sports cars he wants. The questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner. He marks some cars in fixed locations and you can steal others off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to check if it is on the list, then drive it back to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Delivering in good condition pays more. It can all be done after the story.
steps: Play Chapter 3 until Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (unlocks the Key Cloner).
Check Randy's Wish List under Map, Robberies.
Deliver all 16 wanted sports cars to Randy's garage.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's questline, available only as Jason. It is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter, and after enough labs are destroyed Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This. All of it stays available after the story.
steps: Play as Jason in Chapter 3 until Here, Kitty Kitty.
Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City.
Complete Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts double at the same location. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: the first meditation happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That session adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a meditation spot, so it is still unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway, while you still can. You cannot do the final meditation until both characters can play together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends.
After Coffee Break, meditate at the remaining spots with both characters.
Track spots under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret Vogel's hunting questline, exclusive to Jason. It is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. The questline stays available after the story, and the 15 Target Decks it uses are also needed for the 100% checklist.
steps: Play as Jason after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, until Bret texts you.
Meet Bret in Lummox County (Veteran Hunted).
Hunt the animals he marks and bring them back to him.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card set locations in total, so pick the three easiest sets to finish and leave the rest. Cards are found across Leonida — work on them while you explore for The Goodtime State and the WAiNK scans.
steps: Find collectible cards while exploring Leonida.
Complete any 3 full sets.
The trophy pops when the third set is complete.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up on the D-pad and then R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are far more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — so scan whatever you pass. Stand on a busy street and scan vehicles and landmarks as you go; this pairs naturally with Whip It Good and the 200 vehicle scans needed for 100%.
steps: Open the WAiNK app with Up on the D-pad.
Look at landmarks, curiosities and sculptures and hold R1 to scan.
Scan any 100 locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. For the 100% checklist you need 70 of 80, so this trophy unlocks automatically on the way to A Long Road. View and track challenges under Progress, Challenges. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies — leave this for late, then pick the easiest remaining ones.
steps: Work on other trophies first — challenges complete passively.
Check Progress, Challenges for what is left.
Pick the easiest remaining challenges until you reach 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone. You can only do this after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can free-roam together — call your partner with Right on the D-pad plus Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports motorcycle; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County works well because cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone. It also comes automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, when the large bank vault robberies trigger 4-star wanted levels.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner (Right + Triangle).
Reach a 4-star wanted level together.
Escape the red heat zone — a fast bike and the Ambrosia train tunnel help.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time — do not lose the cops between shops. You can only start after Chapter 2, Coffee Break. Equip an armored vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and carry Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, unlocked after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: rob a couple of items in each store and break the safe with sticky bombs. If it does not pop after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop.
steps: After Coffee Break, call your partner and gear up (vest, sticky bombs).
Rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level.
Wait about 30 seconds after the third shop — the pop is delayed.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). The fastest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. You need 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned for the 100% checklist, so this trophy comes automatically. Check discovered vehicles under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up).
Scan vehicles on busy roads — scanning counts, driving is not needed.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first — eat or drink, wash your face or shower at home, and consume Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to extend it. Then line up 5 enemies, for example criminals at a gang operation, and drop them quickly without missing; an assault rifle like the Duke 556 is more accurate than pistols and SMGs. Wear body armor from Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels — raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — so this gets easier late in the game.
steps: Raise Focus to level 4 (shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing).
Buff focus, then activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3) while aiming.
Take down 5 enemies in that one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. The easiest is the one at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed.
steps: Go to VCIA and reach the plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Board it, enter the cockpit and taxi backwards to the runway.
Take off and fly 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — and use it. The tanks stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy unlocks.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County.
Enter the base (gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance).
Climb into a tank in the south of the base and fire at enemies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map. Break in through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door triggers the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 (unlocks the Snap Gun).
Enter a jewelry store through the back door using the Snap Gun.
Find the safe code note, loot the safe, leave undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces bank vault robberies: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip to mark security vans with purple icons (finish his earlier quests first, including robbing 2 Payday Loans). Each vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this trophy comes automatically. A single vault can pay up to $205,000.
steps: Finish That's Where The Money Is in Chapter 4 (first vault is part of it).
Buy Yasmani's security-van tips ($10,000 each) to find more vaults.
Rob any 5 vaults and escape each time.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is the same Chapter 4 optional mission that unlocks bank vaults, That's Where The Money Is: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Or do it earlier in free-roam: block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. The trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius (a Pay 'n' Spray helps). You need all 8 large bank jobs for the 100% checklist anyway, so this usually pops by itself.
steps: Tail an armored truck to a bank, or block one and blow its back door.
Grab the cash.
Escape the red heat radius.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every area that is still black fog on the map until the entire map is visible. This pairs naturally with the stunt flights and the exploration you do for cards, meditations and WAiNK scans.
steps: Get a plane.
Fly over every fogged area of the map.
Keep going until no black fog remains.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this trophy comes automatically on the way to A Long Road. Operations are marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Track per-gang progress under Progress, Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
steps: Follow yellow operation icons on the map.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Check Progress, Gangs to see which gangs are left.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The method for this trophy is not yet confirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown. The description points to Ocean Beach — go there, find a bar or venue with a view, and order a cocktail. This atlas will be updated when a reliable method is confirmed; the guide text here says plainly what is known and what is not, rather than inventing a location.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Find a bar or venue with a view and order a cocktail.
If it does not pop, check back — the method is still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You can only steal it after obtaining the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (steal the Zorrusso for Randy): hack into the car, drive forward through the window, and the trophy pops a moment later once you are further down the street. Only this blue Banshee works — it is an easter egg reference to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Unlock the Key Cloner in Chapter 3 (Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs).
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack the blue Banshee.
Drive it straight through the showroom window.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first — you need them to destroy the safe. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and loot the safe in the north-east hallway (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police. It is not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while and you can go back for the rest.
steps: Buy sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation.
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2, Hit Kingpin Bowling).
Steal the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents, then escape the police.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can only start after Chapter 2, Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason and Lucia, then scroll to Strength (heart icon). Increase it by working out — buy a fitness club membership and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while one character actively works out, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon). You can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After Coffee Break, check both characters' Strength levels.
Work out together at a fitness club — training one trains both.
Reach maximum strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) — a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Profile levels run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable, which is permanent if you keep using excessive violence. You will almost certainly reach 500 passively while working on the other trophies and the 100% checklist — every robbery and enemy encounter counts. If anything is left at the end, it can be farmed quickly, but note that cops shoot on sight more often at Psycho or Irredeemable.
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, UI.
Play normally — robberies and encounters count toward the 500.
Check the trophy in the trophy list to see your count.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The method for this trophy is not yet confirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description — second time's the charm — suggests retrying something after a first failure. This atlas says plainly what is known and what is not, rather than inventing a method; check back when a reliable trigger is confirmed.
steps: Keep playing the story and the Payday Loans content.
If a Payday Loans task fails, retry it — 'second time's the charm'.
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed; check back for an update.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. Go alone to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2 AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it appears. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside. The spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed, so be patient.
steps: Go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, after 2 AM.
Wait for the blinking car, then follow the path into the woods.
Approach the UFO, talk to the woman it drops, and return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The method for this trophy is not yet confirmed: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle. The description suggests a melee attack from a moving vehicle — try kicking enemies off a bike while riding past them. This atlas says plainly what is known and what is not, rather than inventing a method; check back when a reliable trigger is confirmed.
steps: Get on a motorcycle.
Ride past enemies and try kicking them with a melee attack.
The exact trigger is still unconfirmed; check back for an update.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — it counts across all robberies, you do not need $250,000 at once. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meet Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is. This comes naturally while doing all robberies for the 100% checklist.
steps: Finish Chapter 3, Credit Check (unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer).
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Deliver $250,000 total to a fence — Yasmani pays the most.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest route because they are the most expensive. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores — spending anywhere counts, so just buy the expensive things you want while playing and this pops on its own.
steps: Spend across any shops — guns, car mods and tattoos are fastest.
Track the total in this atlas with the counter.
Reach $100,000 spent in total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story-related garages, which do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (steal the Crawler for Moses): you get a notification that a new app, Vice City Real Estate, was installed on your phone. Buy the garages through the phone app. Robberies are the quickest way to make the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4.
steps: Play Chapter 2 until Daily Driver (unlocks Vice City Real Estate).
Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy all 8 garages ($160,000 total).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (take a vehicle to Moses), and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. You need enough garage space first — see Little Boxes: each garage adds parking spots. Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, and in his garage choose Respray and Register. He only accepts vehicles without trackers at first; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
steps: Buy garages first (Little Boxes) for parking spots.
Steal a vehicle and drive it to Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Choose Respray and Register — repeat for 10 vehicles.
